Let’s evaluate step by step.

1. Start with the expression:  
   \( ( \text{not} ( \text{True} ) ) \)

2. Resolve the innermost parentheses:  
   Inside we have \( \text{True} \).  
   Apply the NOT operator:  
   \( \text{not} ( \text{True} ) = \text{False} \)

3. Now the expression becomes:  
   \( ( \text{False} ) \)  
   This simplifies to \( \text{False} \).

4. Final result: \( \text{False} \)

Final answer: false
